actor.role: You act in a household text environment to complete the task. Each turn, write one short line 'Think: ...' and then 'Action: <one command>'.

planner.role: You read the task and the room, and write a short plan for the teammate who will act: where to look first and the steps to finish. You do not act.

rules: Every task: an actor with valid_actions.
Tasks with two objects or with cleaning, heating or cooling: a planner, then the actor reading its plan.

Give the actor the skill matching the task type: 'look at X under lamp'→look_in_light; 'hot/heat X'→heat_task; 'cool/cold X'→cool_task; 'clean X'→clean_task; 'two X'→pick_two; other placement→pick_place. Also give search_order if the target object is not initially in view.
Give the actor the stuck_recovery skill on every task.

action_syntax.text: Commands: go to {recep}; open {recep}; close {recep}; take {obj} from {recep}; move {obj} to {recep}; clean {obj} with {sinkbasin}; heat {obj} with {microwave}; cool {obj} with {fridge}; use {lamp}; examine {obj or recep}; inventory; look. Use the exact names with numbers as they appear ('mug 1', 'countertop 2'). You can hold one object; you must be at a receptacle to take from or move to it. 'Nothing happens' means the command was invalid: change it, do not repeat it.

search_order.when: the target object is not in view (most tasks)
search_order.text: Search likely places first and never revisit a checked place. When you arrive at a closed receptacle, your next action MUST be 'open {recep}'. Typical: food -> fridge, countertop, diningtable, sinkbasin, garbagecan; dishes -> countertop, cabinet, diningtable, sinkbasin, shelf, drawer; small items -> desk, drawer, sidetable, dresser, shelf; towels/cloths -> handtowelholder, towelholder, countertop, toilet, cabinet; books/laptops -> desk, bed, sofa, sidetable.

pick_place.when: put an object in/on a receptacle
pick_place.text: 1. Find the exact object type named in the task (a cup is not a mug, a cloth is not a towel), take it. 2. Go to the target receptacle; open it if closed. 3. move {obj} to {recep}. The task is done when the object is placed.

pick_two.when: put two objects of a type in/on a receptacle
pick_two.text: 1. Find the first object, take it, move it to the target. 2. Go back to searching for the second one (it may be elsewhere; remember where you saw others). 3. Move the second to the same target. You can carry only one object at a time.

clean_task.text: 1. Find and take the EXACT object type named in the task (a towel is not a cloth, a handtowel is not a cloth). 2. go to sinkbasin 1 (the command is just 'go to sinkbasin 1'; you must already be holding the object), then 'clean {obj} with sinkbasin 1'. Do NOT move the object into the sink. 3. Go to the target, open it if needed, move the object there.

heat_task.when: put a hot or heated object somewhere
heat_task.text: 1. Find and take the EXACT object type named in the task (a mug is not a cup). 2. go to microwave 1 (the command is just 'go to microwave 1'; you must already be holding the object), then 'heat {obj} with microwave 1'. Do NOT open the microwave or move the object inside. 3. Go to the target, open it if needed, move the object there.

cool_task.when: put a cool or cold object somewhere
cool_task.text: 1. Find and take the EXACT object type named in the task (a mug is not a cup, a towel is not a cloth). 2. go to fridge 1 (the command is just 'go to fridge 1'; you must already be holding the object), then 'cool {obj} with fridge 1'. Do NOT open the fridge or move the object inside. 3. Go to the target, open it if needed, move the object there. If the target is the fridge itself this is a plain placement.

look_in_light.when: examine or look at an object with/under a lamp
look_in_light.text: 1. Find and take the object. 2. Find a desklamp or floorlamp (often on a desk, sidetable or dresser). 3. Go to the lamp while holding the object and 'use {lamp}'. Using the lamp while holding the object completes the task.

stuck_recovery.text: If a command returns 'Nothing happens' twice, STOP repeating it. Check inventory, then go to a new unvisited place. After the final successful placement ('You move the X to the Y'), the task is done: do not type 'done' or any further command.

valid_actions.doc: after every observation, the list of commands that are valid right now.

memory.doc: after every observation, a summary of the places visited so far and what was seen in each (closed/empty receptacles included).

goal_reminder.doc: after every observation, the task again and the number of steps left.
